title: The Mitten String Shared Between Hooks
youtube_title: The Mitten String Shared Between Hooks | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Esme sees that a mitten string long enough for two hooks will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Esme makes a smaller, even share so Teo is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
